plan.notes: Official Stark State College 2025-2026 Catalog curriculum guide (program code 7100, Rev. 1-2025, effective Summer 2025): semester-by-semester course sequence for full-time Associate of Arts – General students finishing in two years. The guide prints semester ranges 13 / 12-16 / 16-17 / 14-25 and 'TOTAL CREDITS 60-65' because the math, natural science, and fourth-semester elective blocks vary in credit hours; this seed models the minimum-credit instantiation (math elective 3 credits, second-semester natural science 3 credits, third-semester natural science 4 credits, fourth-semester elective block 19 credits to reach the 60-credit minimum) for semesters 13 / 12 / 16 / 19 = 60, and notes the guide's 60-65 range. Elective menus as printed: Arts and Humanities (ENG233, ENG234, ENG235, ENG236, ENG237, ENG239, ENG240, ENG241, HIS121, HIS122, HIS221, HIS222, PHL122); Mathematics, Statistics, and Logic (MTH118, MTH124, MTH125, MTH130, MTH135, MTH223, MTH224, MTH225, MTH226, MTH227); Natural Science (BIO101, BIO121, BIO122, BIO124, BIO126, BIO127, BIO128, BIO129, BIO130, BIO141, BIO142, BIO221, BIO241, BIO242, CHM100, CHM101, CHM105, CHM123, CHM141, CHM142, CHM205, CHM241, CHM242, PHY101, PHY105, PHY121, PHY122, PHY221, PHY222); English Composition and Oral Communication (COM121, COM122, COM123, COM125, COM126, ENG221, ENG230, ENG231); Social and Behavioral Science (BUS122, BUS221, BUS222, PSC121, PSY121, PSY123, PSY124, PSY220, PSY221, SOC121, SOC122, SOC123, SOC225); general electives (ASL121, ASL122, ASL124, ASL221, BIO123, BIO222, CJS121, CJS129, CJS221, COM223, ENG125, ENG126, ENG227, ENG228, ENG229, ENG232, ENG238, GER121, GER122, PSC122, PSC221, PSC222, PSY131, PSY222, SOC222, SPN100, SPN200, SSC201, or any additional listed-category course). ENG124 is required. Footnote markers (^ placement score, ^^ take first semester, term-availability symbols) are advising notes, not course prerequisites.
